info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

BbvAccountMapping.title: BBV Account Mapping
BbvAccountMapping.description: Maps an RGS account to a BBV taakveld for a specific administration (gemeente, provincie, or waterschap). Unique per (administrationId, accountNumber). Per ADR-022, this is a register — not an embedded enum or link table.

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber (T1 chart of accounts).

taakveld.description: BBV taakveld code from the BbvTaakveld catalogue (REQ-BBV-005). e.g. '0.1', '5.3'.

bcfCompensable.description: Whether the account's VAT is recoverable via BCF (Btw Compensatiefonds). See bookkeeping-bcf-vat-compensation.

iv3Bucket.description: IV3 reporting bucket for this account mapping. See bookkeeping-iv3-reporting.

active.label: Active
active.description: Mapping is active and applied to new GL postings.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Mapping is archived; no longer applied to new postings.

restore.label: Restore mapping
restore.description: Reactivate an archived BBV account mapping.

approval-workflow.description: bcfCompensable flag flips and taakveld reassignments may require approval per administration policy (REQ-BBV-009).

account.description: FK to the T1 Account schema (chart of accounts).

bbvTaakveld.description: FK to the BbvTaakveld catalogue entry.

byTaakveld.description: Number of accounts mapped per taakveld.

byProgramma.description: Number of accounts mapped per programma code.

bbvProgrammaSummary.description: Sum of GL debits and credits per programmaCode for BBV reporting (REQ-BBV-004). Joins BbvAccountMapping with GLLine via accountNumber.

BbvTaakveld.title: BBV Taakveld
BbvTaakveld.description: A taakveld entry from the BBV bijlage IV catalogue (Besluit Begroting en Verantwoording). Seeded from bbv-taakvelden-2024.json. Per D2, this is a register because the catalogue evolves at every BBV revision and needs translation handling.

taakveldCode.description: BBV taakveld code from bijlage IV. e.g. '0.1', '1.2', '7.1'.

name.description: Official taakveld name per Besluit BBV bijlage IV.

legalBasis.description: Statutory citation: Besluit BBV bijlage IV §X.

effectiveFrom.description: Start of the taakveld's validity window.

effectiveTo.description: End of validity window; null means the taakveld is still current.

active.label: Active
active.description: Taakveld is current and in the active BBV catalogue.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: Replaced by a newer BBV catalogue revision.

supersede.label: Mark as superseded
supersede.description: Mark this taakveld as replaced by a newer BBV revision.

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: General-ledger posting header. Owns the balance invariant and lifecycle. Extended here with a BBV-mapping precondition for municipal administrations (REQ-BBV-003). Full T1 field set declared in bookkeeping-general-ledger spec.

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction number unique per administration + fiscal year.

postingDate.description: Effective accounting date of the posting.

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for this posting.

sourceReference.description: External document number (invoice, bank statement ref, etc.).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the GL transaction.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this posting.

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry that materialised this posting.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Posting in preparation — lines may be added or edited.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Balanced, immutable posting in the general ledger.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Posting has been reversed by a counter-entry.

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Finalise and post this GL transaction. For municipal administrations (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) every GLLine.accountNumber MUST have a non-archived BbvAccountMapping for the same administration and postingDate >= installation date (REQ-BBV-003, forward-only).

bbvMappingPresent.check: ALL GLLine.accountNumber RESOLVED IN BbvAccountMapping WHERE administrationId = GLTransaction.administrationId AND lifecycleState = 'active'
bbvMappingPresent.errorMessage: BBV mapping required: account {accountNumber} has no active BbvAccountMapping for this administration.

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Create a reversing counter-entry. Requires a corresponding reversal GLTransaction.
